correctness.rationale: For R(x)=f(x)a, the defining identity is equivalent to common left/right eigenfunctional equations and \(a^2=(\lambda+\mu)a\). In kQ/J² the square-zero generators are precisely nonzero radical vectors; their left/right sum has rank \(r(S)\) of the bipartite support-incidence graph. All idempotents with a given binary diagonal are unipotently conjugate, and their off-diagonal Peirce spaces have dimensions u(B),v(B). These facts prove the two summands in (1), with division by \(q-1\) only for square-zero generators. The Tutte expansion and path transfer-matrix recurrence are algebraic identities. Direct identity-based enumeration over 13 small quiver/field configurations reproduced counts, including GF(4) and a separated-graph cycle. This is proof plus finite corroboration, not extrapolation.
